items.title: Why Malaysia Lost Me To NHS Scotland — Scrub Nurse With HIV
items.summary: In Malaysia, I experienced job discrimination as a scrub nurse living with HIV from private hospitals and MOH. But NHS Scotland hired me, allowing me to work in OT.
